visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with blonde hair and glasses, wearing a brown hoodie and joggers, stands in a bright white minimalist room. He has his hands on the handles of two upright suitcases: a silver one on the left and a black one on the right. Large white text overlays appear at the top. (2) The scene cuts to a top-down view of an open suitcase filled with folded clothes. Hands are visible adjusting the items. Inset graphics and text explain the suitcase's interior structure and the '5:5' opening style. (3) The man demonstrates the use of a transparent plastic protective cover for the luggage in the same studio setting. Subsequent cuts show him opening and closing the suitcases to display the internal storage space and front-opening features. (4) Close-up shots highlight a digital scale built into the suitcase handle, showing weight readings. The man's hands are shown pressing buttons on the handle to operate the scale. (5) The creator demonstrates the luggage's mobility by pushing the suitcases across the studio floor and then on an outdoor street sidewalk, rolling over a manhole cover to show wheel smoothness. (6) A catalog-style graphic appears on a white background, showcasing various luggage colors and models (pink, blue, white, black, marble pattern) with detailed specifications. (7) The man concludes by standing with the suitcases in the studio, using expressive facial expressions and hand gestures to emphasize his recommendation. Promotional price text is displayed on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins in Traditional Chinese, characterized by a fast speech rate and enthusiastic tone. Upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady synth beat at 124 BPM plays continuously. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' SFX signals a visual change. The narrator explains specific luggage features with high pitch variability for emphasis while the music remains a rhythmic foundation. (3) Sound of plastic crinkling and high-frequency rustling occurs as the luggage cover is handled. This is immediately followed by a dull 'thud' and the sound of mechanical zippers as suitcases are manipulated. (4) Short, sharp digital UI beeps are audible, indicating the operation of the electronic scale. The speaker's articulation is clear and professional against the BGM. (5) Acoustic texture shifts to a field recording background: low-frequency rolling sounds of wheels on hard surfaces and distant urban traffic hum under the narration. (6) Music volume swells slightly during a product showcase montage. The speaker's arousal level remains high while announcing promotional details. (7) Final hard cuts in the audio track conclude the presentation. The narrator delivers a final positive recommendation with rising intonation before the music and vocals cease simultaneously.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Feature Breakdown -> Physical Demonstration -> Social Proof/Testimonial -> Price Reveal -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This is a social media influencer marketing video designed to promote a group buy for Flexflow luggage. The creator uses high-energy delivery and physical demonstrations to highlight unique selling points, specifically the integrated weighing scale and smooth-rolling wheels, to encourage immediate purchase via a limited-time offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly addresses the audience to recommend the luggage, demonstrates its specific features, displays official promotional pricing, and mentions a 'group buy' event.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-density editing style typical of social media commerce, combining studio-quality product shots with amateur-style field tests to build authenticity.
